MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this Brake Response.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this Brake Response.

BrakeResponseID.description: Unique identifier of this Brake Response instance.

BrakeResponseTime.description: Time this Brake Response was produced.

BrakeResponseSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Brake Response applies.

BrakeID.description: Identifier of the Brake producing this response.

BrakeState.description: Operational state of the Brake (e.g., Applied, Released, Fault, Overheated).

BrakePressure.description: Hydraulic or actuator pressure reported by the brake module (bar or Pa).

BrakeForceApplied.description: Estimated caliper or actuator force applied (N).

BrakeTorqueEstimate.description: Brake torque estimate derived from caliper force or EMB motor current (N·m).

BrakePadWear.description: Remaining pad life as a fraction from 0.0 (fully worn) to 1.0 (new).

ABSActivation.description: Indicates whether ABS/ESC is currently modulating brake pressure.

WheelSlipRatio.description: Slip ratio derived from wheel-speed sensors and vehicle-speed estimation.

BrakeEventDuration.description: Duration (ms) of the braking event from start to response time.

OverheatFlag.description: Indicates that brake thermal thresholds have been exceeded.

SensorDegradationFlag.description: Indicates degraded pad-wear or brake-temperature sensor behaviour.

LinePressureAnomaly.description: Indicates hydraulic or actuator pressure irregularities.

ErrorCode.description: Fault or diagnostic code reported by the brake subsystem.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Brake Response in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Brake Response (plain text, max 2048 characters).
